Thanks for reaching out! We'd love to chat about setting up a standard visit for you next week.

Our standard visit is priced at **$180**. To get the ball rolling, I'd suggest scheduling a quick call so we can confirm the details and find a time that works best for you.

Please let me know your availability or feel free to suggest a day and time — we'll do our best to accommodate you.

Looking forward to connecting!

Best regards,
Acme Services

Looking forward to connecting!

Acme Services
